name: Release room
description: Changes -> build -> tests -> release notes -> deployment approval. Produces versioned release artifacts and an approval trail. Build and test status come from locally executed commands, never from an external CI system.
requiredResult: Versioned release artifacts and approval trail

steps.title: Collect changes for {{version}}
steps.instructions: Run git log since the previous tag and write the change list to release/{{version}}/changes.md. Record the exact git command.

steps.title: Build {{version}}
steps.instructions: Run the project build command. Record the command and its exit code in release/{{version}}/build.md. A build is green only when the recorded exit code is 0.
steps.deliverable: Executed build command with exit code 0

steps.title: Test {{version}}
steps.instructions: Run the project test command against the built artifact. Report the command and the exit code.

steps.title: Write release notes for {{version}}
steps.instructions: Write release/{{version}}/RELEASE_NOTES.md from the change list and the recorded build and test results. State the build and test commands with their exit codes. Finish with JSON matching the output schema.

statusSource.description: Agent Space has no CI/CD connector in this build

steps.title: Approve deployment of {{version}}
steps.instructions: Review the release notes, the recorded build exit code, and the recorded test exit code, then record an explicit deployment decision. Agent Space does not deploy: a deploy command is a policy-gated approval request.

rubric.criterion: Build status came from an executed command
rubric.howMeasured: A recorded command matching build/compile/package reported exit code 0
rubric.failsWhen: The notes call the build green with no recorded exit code

rubric.criterion: Test status came from an executed command
rubric.howMeasured: A test-output artifact exists and a test command reported exit code 0
rubric.failsWhen: The notes claim tests pass with no recorded test command

rubric.criterion: No external CI status is claimed
rubric.howMeasured: statusSource is local-command; this build has no CI/CD connector
rubric.failsWhen: A release note quotes a pipeline or deployment status that Agent Space never observed

rubric.howMeasured: The approve step produced a final message artifact and, when a deploy command was attempted, an approval row
rubric.failsWhen: The release is marked approved with no recorded decision

notes: requiredConnectors lists ci-cd, which is NOT implemented in this build (see docs/EXTENSIONS.md). Until a CI connector exists, every build and deployment status in this pack must come from a command executed here with a recorded exit code.
